record.title: Collect And Win
record.body:
<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added "Collect & Win" live event: collect tokens in levels, track progress, claim stage rewards and a grand prize; main screen, progress widget, info panel, stage/prize items, and level-end token display.

* **Improvements**
  * Tokens spawn in unlocked levels, persist on level win, can be saved/claimed; new VFX/animations and reward-screen queuing.

* **Developer Tools**
  * Debug panel options to add tokens and reset event data; new backend requests to support the flow.

* **Chores**
  * Added sprites, prefabs, materials and asset metadata for the event.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

record.title: Collect And Win minor bugs fixes
record.body:
Fixes:
* When the page opened, it shows placeholder images at first.
* After level completion, it first shows placeholder icon and progress for the event, then shows the correct one
* In every level, I got two errors both backend and client. 
* In Boss arena and endless mode, the c&w UI is visible. 

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- Refactor
  - Collect & Win screens now use pooled UI items for faster loading, smoother scrolling, reduced flicker, improved ordering and cleanup when refreshing content.
- New Features
  - Auto-scrolls to the first unclaimed reward/grand prize when opening the screen.
  - Reward and grand-prize items now reflect claimed state (labels hidden for claimed stages).
- Bug Fixes
  - Next Reward icon visibility corrected based on event lock.
  - Token counter/panel shown only when relevant (avoids Endless/Infinite Boss modes).
  - UI elements remain hidden until data/initialization to prevent brief flashes.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

record.title: Implement Win&Collect into Queue Manager
record.body:
Implement Win&Collect into Queue Manager

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Prevents premature progression during reward animations by waiting for Collect & Win status when available.
  * Reduces unnecessary delays, improving responsiveness and shortening input-block time after rewards.
  * Adds a timeout guard to avoid stalls if visual effects don’t complete promptly.

* **Refactor**
  * Streamlined reward VFX flow with clearer, coroutine-driven sequencing.
  * Exposed an explicit method to trigger Collect & Win status checks, allowing more precise timing with UI updates and effects.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

record.title: Collect And Win Analytics and title change
record.body:
<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- New Features
  - App emits and tracks Collect & Win start and reward-claimed events (includes event duration, stage, and reward details).
- Improvements
  - Total event duration now computed from explicit start and end times for more accurate reporting.
  - Screens update and report timing consistently across flows.
- Bug Fixes
  - Initial color/state corrected to avoid an unintended default on load.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
